messages:
kelly: Dropped a short prototype — compact token list where each token is a chip + inline status. Want feedback on copy, reveal, and undo. GIF attached.

noah: Love density. One ask: make copy explicit. Don't make the whole chip copy on click.

sara: Agreed. Suggested pattern: chip click = details, copy button inside chip (aria-label="Copy key to clipboard"), reveal behind modal.

design-bot: Accessibility notes: 1) Do not put secret text in aria-live. 2) Toast on copy should read "Key copied" (aria-live polite). 3) Reveal modal must focus trap and require an extra confirmation click.

mike: For revoke, rename to "Disable key" and provide an undo toast with keyboard-focusable "Undo" for 6s. If user needs permanent deletion, move to advanced.

tess: Edge-case: bulk disable while items are mid-rotation. Show conflict modal listing affected keys and require per-item confirmation.

kelly: Microcopy for empty state draft: "No API tokens yet. Create a token to get started." Primary CTA "Create token"; secondary link "Scopes explained"; hint: press C.

noah: Small UI nit: inline pending skeleton must keep fixed height to avoid pagination jumps. Mobile: collapse to stacked rows.

sara: SR tweak: reveal button toggles aria-pressed and changes label to "Hide secret". Add SR-only text before reveal: "Secret will appear on screen."

design-bot: Perf note: cache scope summaries per page and lazy-load details on hover/focus to avoid N+1 fetches.

kelly: Action items: @mike implement undo toast + telemetry (no secret), @sara add SR copy snippets, @noah produce responsive skeleton, @design-bot update comps with explicit copy icon. Prototype review next Wed. :thumbsup:
